title: Recomputed per-class column math renders colliding/clipped headers in the PR's own after-captures
evidence:
sla_x := loss_r + 16
	rate_r := px + NOC_PANEL_W - 6
	if noc_row_visible(cur, scroll, visible) {
		y := noc_row_y(cur, scroll)
		draw_mono_c(v, "class", name_x, y, NOC_SIZE_LABEL, NOC_LABEL)
		draw_mono_c(v, "del", del_r, y, NOC_SIZE_LABEL, NOC_LABEL)
		draw_mono_c(v, "drop", drop_r, y, NOC_SIZE_LABEL, NOC_LABEL)
		draw_mono_c(v, "loss", loss_r, y, NOC_SIZE_LABEL, NOC_LABEL)
		draw_mono_c(v, "SLA", sla_x, y, NOC_SIZE_LABEL, NOC_LABEL)
		draw_mono_c(v, "/3s", rate_r, y, NOC_SIZE_LABEL, NOC_LABEL)
detail: Headers are LEFT-aligned at right-edge anchors. Verified in shipped captures after-rail-real-run.png and after-rail-qos-contention.png: "loss" (starts x=1134, ~36px wide at 15px) overlaps "SLA" at sla_x=1150, rendering an unreadable "loSLA" jumble; "/3s" starts at rate_r=1262 and runs to ~1289, clipped at the 1280 window edge (past the panel's own 1268 inset). Violates spec scope 3 "recompute the column math" and the AC "KYLE legibility verdict (PASS)" claim of "labels readable / hierarchy clear".
recommended_fix: Right-align the del/drop/loss//3s headers to their column right edges (use noc_col) and place SLA with real clearance after the loss column (e.g. sla_x = loss_r + measured label gap); re-capture and re-grade.

title: Supplied pr-body.md contradicts the code and the in-repo PR body the diff ships
evidence: pr-body.md: "Ring buffer stays 256 (`NOC_LOG_CAP`). Visible rows: 24 at 1280×720 (was 37)" and "The crisis banner + settings modal + mode label + audio caption re-anchor to `play_w`" — vs app/render/noc_overlay_test.odin:260 `testing.expect(t, visible == 23, "23 visible rows at 1280x720 (574px / 24px rows)")`, app/main.odin:1609 `draw_text(app, mode_label, app.view.win_w - rnd.hud(&app.view, 320), ...)` and app/main.odin:2250 `x := (app.view.win_w - w) / 2` (audio caption)
detail: Supplied PR body claims 24 visible rows (code/tests pin 23), claims mode label + audio caption re-anchor to play_w (both stay at win_w; the shipped _pr_body_noc_readability_2.md says the bottom band stays at win_w), and says "plate at x=757" (actual 756). Stale claims doc.
recommended_fix: Regenerate the outer pr-body.md from the shipped _pr_body_noc_readability_2.md (which is already consistent with the code) before posting.
